changelog: Notes+ 19.5: more reliable sync. No more "Conflicted copy" notes, shared notes keep their identity, and a note left open still syncs. Widgets can now be added from inside the app (a list's menu: Add to home screen; the notes menu: Add a widget) for home screens that don't list them. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 19.5 for Windows: no more "Conflicted copy" notes (a shared note can no longer be overwritten by one), and a note left open in a window still syncs.
